metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Commemorate 30 years of joy with fan-favorite Pokémon spanning three dazzling decades! Celebrate this magnificent milestone with the mighty presences of Mewtwo ex and Mew ex, followed by a wealth of allies like Umbreon ex, Salamence ex, and Greninja ex. Plus, there are 30 reasons to honor Pikachu, as each booster pack contains one—with 30 unique variations to collet as Pikachu rare cards! And, whether you're looking forward to a glittering future or taking a nostalgic look at a storied past, there are a host of treasures to find and secrets to reveal in the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration!

Each Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box contains:

• 9 Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs (cards vary by pack)

• 1 full-art foil promo featuring Nidorina

• 16 foil Basic Energy cards

• 65-ct standard-sized card sleeves

• A player's guide to the 30th Celebration expansion

• 6 damage-counter dice

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 1 plastic coin

• A collector's box to hold everything, with 6 dividers to keep it organized

• A code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live

source.presaleNote: This product is a Presale item with an estimated shipping date of 9/16/2026. Please keep in mind card details, including rarity and card name, may change up until release date as information is updated.

A Special Day Filled with Friends!

Celebrate the adventurous past, exciting present, and brilliant future of the Pokémon Trading Card Game with a massive collection of cards, accessories, and fun! Leading the party as powerful Pokémon ex, Pikachu and Espeon have invited lots of friends to their day out in the sun—and you can join the festivities with the playmat, card sleeves, deck box, and other accessories in this collection.
